Subject: Playbook: final go/no-go, signature path & start‑date onramp

Lisa —

Quick playbook for the final MAP steps so we can lock a clean start date the week of 7/12. TL;DR: target e‑sign window = 7/06–7/08, approvals routed by 7/02. If anything slips we propose a one‑week contingency start.

Key items:
- Approvals: Octane procurement signoff (Lisa + Legal lead), Redwood legal review done by 6/29, CS onboarding approval by 7/01.
- Signature timing: propose DocuSign envelope sent 7/06 PST; counter‑sign expected 48h. Please confirm primary signer and their exact email for the envelope.
- Start date: target customer‑facing start 7/12; internal preflight week (7/05–7/09) for capacity pin and runbook dry run.
- Dependencies: SOC2 snapshot and data residency confirmation (EEA vs US) — see attached Security_Evidence.zip.

Attached: MAP_Octane_v2.xlsx (mutual action timeline), SLA_Draft_v3.pdf (escalation/SLOs), Security_Evidence.zip (redacted artifacts).

Asks for you:
1) Confirm intended signer name + email by EOD 6/15.
2) Confirm whether Octane requires any contract redlines beyond the attached SLA draft (legal contact on CC helps).
3) Any specific start‑of‑day constraints for 7/12 (timezone, onboarding hours)?

If we get the confirmations above, Ben and I will: 1) route a final legal clean copy to Redwood Legal (target 6/24), 2) reserve Dedicated capacity for the ramp week, and 3) queue the DocuSign envelope for 7/06.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this cleanly.

—

Marissa — thanks, this is very clear. A few quick notes from Octane:

- Primary signer will be me (Lisa Chen). Please use lisa@octanesys.com for DocuSign.
- Legal will review the SLA; David Park (procurement counsel) is on CC and will flag any material redlines by 6/22.
- SOC2: we can accept Redwood's SOC2 summary (we still need the detail around user audit logs). I pulled those files into our procurement tracker — if you can confirm the single PDF we should expect, David will route internally.
- Data residency: Octane requires US hosting for production, but we can accept EU for non‑prod. Please confirm your US region and that logs are retained per SLA.

We are comfortable with a 7/12 start, assuming approvals land as discussed. If legal flags anything substantial we will push, but we'll try to keep the signing window.

Looping in a couple operational details we should land before DocuSign:

- Legal handoff: I'll send the marked SLA to Legal today and ask for a 72h turnaround. If Redwood Legal needs a buffer, we should aim to have the envelope ready but not sent until we get the green.
- Signer verification: because Lisa is the primary signer, we should attach the standard corporate signer attestation in the envelope (simple checkbox + corporate title). Kimberly — can you prepare the attestation language?
- Contingency: recommend we prepare a fallback start of 7/19 with a soft onboarding (reduced traffic & extended support). Offer: if legal causes >5 calendar days slip, Redwood extends complimentary 30 days of elevated support credits. I'll add that as a clause in the MAP so Sales/CS alignment is explicit.

Also, small ops ask — Kimberly, confirm the Dedicated pool reservation for week of 7/05 (GPU count 4, baseline throughput). If you confirm, I'll lock it.
